propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external test modules still call it, causing AttributeError in 4 CI lanes of the Live External Integration workflow.

tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and tests/external/test_llm_trace.py call the removed review_ticket() function and must be retargeted to a surviving API (review_plan or review_code) whose result contract matches the tests' existing assertions.

review_plan() returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (no top-level findings field) while both tests assert result['findings'] and validate schemas.REVIEW_RESULT, so review_plan cannot satisfy the tests; review_code() returns REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings and is the correct retarget.
The removal epic's verification gate excluded external tests, so the broken call sites were never exercised and the regression remained invisible until live workflow_dispatch runs.
Both call sites must be retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code with assertions and schema validation adapted to REVIEW_RESULT contract.
